level1.title: This Is My Body
level1.story: Jesus ate the Last Supper with His friends. He took bread and said, "This is My Body." He took the cup and said, "This is My Blood."

level2.title: The Last Supper
level2.story: On the first day of the Unleavened Bread, the disciples asked Jesus where to prepare the Passover. He sent two of them into the city, where they found a large upper room ready. While they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and said, "Take ye. This is My body." Taking the chalice, He gave thanks and said, "This is My blood of the new testament, which shall be shed for many." After singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
level2.keyLine: Take ye. This is my body.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus give us the Eucharist?
How can you prepare for Holy Communion?
level2.prayer: Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament, I adore You. Amen.
